author.headline: Expert in applying AI in verification

text:
Batch Review MCP server v1.1 - added wavedorm and math equations to the markdown viewer.

This is a file reviewer built for human and AI to collaborate.   Both human and AI have the same access to the GUI to make comments on the code/text files

One shot the update with Sonnet 5 in 2 hours.
